```python
def get_config_setting(name: str) ->Optional[str]:
    """
    Get a configuration setting from the config file or from URLSettings enum.
    
    Args:
        name: The name of the setting to retrieve
        
    Returns:
        The configuration value or None if not found
    """
    # Try to read from config file first
    if CONFIG and CONFIG.exists():
        try:
            config = configparser.ConfigParser()
            config.read(CONFIG)
            # Look for the setting in the config file
            for section in config.sections():
                if config.has_option(section, name):
                    return config.get(section, name)
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    # Fall back to URLSettings enum
    try:
        return URLSettings[name].value
    except KeyError:
        return None
```
